n: In late December 1830, Joseph and Sidney are told to pause their Bible translation until they move to Ohio, for their safety and because of enemies in New York.

f.g: refers to Joseph’s inspired revision of the Bible (the Joseph Smith Translation).
the region around Kirtland, Ohio, where many converts already lived.

n: Before leaving, they should preach and strengthen the branches, especially the faithful Saints in Colesville.
The first commandment to gather in this dispensation: the Church should assemble in Ohio, in time for Oliver Cowdery’s return from his mission.
This is wise counsel, but everyone must choose for themselves until the Lord comes — the gathering respected personal agency.

f.w: let every man choose for himself
